query: What is the current EMA position on donanemab marketing authorisation?

pubmed.title: Lancet 2025: EMA declined donanemab authorisation
pubmed.summary: A 2025 Lancet report stated the EMA declined donanemab marketing authorisation after an unfavourable benefit–risk assessment. This reflected the status at publication.

europe_pmc.title: July 2025 CHMP positive opinion reversing prior donanemab stance
europe_pmc.summary: In July 2025 the CHMP issued a positive opinion for donanemab, reversing the earlier negative trajectory. The newer regulatory position supersedes prior decline reports.

openalex.title: Timeline of donanemab EU regulatory review
openalex.summary: Donanemab EU review moved from an initial decline narrative to a July 2025 CHMP positive opinion. Readers should treat pre-July 2025 decline statements as superseded.
